chapter: Johnny Hammond, Dreams and moving to New York
title: Hoagy Carmichael children's record and moving to New York with Chico Hamilton
summary: The Stark Reality's odd Hoagy Carmichael album on AJP Records; then he moved permanently to New York for Chico Hamilton.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: the strangest thing in the world. And we recorded them for Ahmad Jamal’s record label, which I think was called AJP Records, which I think had our record on it and maybe one other record and then went bankrupt. My mother is the only person with a copy of this record. It was just hysterical things that I was involved in. And then finally in the early 70s I moved to New York to play with Chico Hamilton on a recommendation from a friend who was leaving the band. And that’s when I moved to stay. And then I never went back to Boston. And then I started becoming a New York musician.
